# Contributing to AssetFlow AI

Thank you for your interest in contributing to AssetFlow AI! This document provides guidelines and instructions for contributing to the project.

## Code of Conduct

By participating in this project, you agree to abide by our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## How to Contribute

### Reporting Issues

- Check if the issue already exists in our [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/your-org/assetflow-ai/issues)
- Use the appropriate issue template (Bug Report, Feature Request, etc.)
- Provide detailed information about the issue
- Include steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior

### Feature Requests

- Check if the feature already exists or is planned
- Use the Feature Request template
- Describe the problem and proposed solution clearly
- Include use cases and implementation suggestions

### Pull Requests

1. **Fork the repository**
2. **Create a feature branch**
   ```bash
   git checkout -b feat/your-feature
   # or
   git checkout -b fix/your-bug-fix
